project.name: Portable configurations
project.description: Inspect and format typed CLI command, run configuration and portable project sources without execution; build ordinary project-relative graphs and import/export independent projects.

entries.name: Validate the authored CLI command envelope
entries.description: Validate literal argv storage, binary identity and supported command/common schema versions. Actual argv grammar is inspected by the shared native command inspector when the project executes it.

entries.name: Run and inspect the authored validation configuration
entries.description: Use the native run-config parser and normalized plan through validate --config, then validate only its explicitly configured project-relative XML input. This is execution, not a standalone run-config source adapter.

entries.name: Validate the portable JSON project manifest
entries.description: Validate native project IDs, resource references, relative paths, hashes and entry-artifact declarations without loading the resource bytes or granting execution.

entries.name: Validate the portable CEM project manifest
entries.description: Validate the canonical CEM encoding of the same portable project using the native Studio project owner.

entries.name: Parse command source
entries.description: Parse original native control syntax and source ranges after typed validation; literal argv and resource paths remain inert.

entries.name: Inspect command source
entries.description: Inspect the typed-admitted original control source and its owned URI/ranges without preparing commands or resolving resource paths.

entries.name: Format command source
entries.description: Format original JSON through the shared native writer, preserving authored fields, literal argv and relative paths without executing them.

entries.name: Validate run config source
entries.description: Validate the authored run-config model and semantic constraints without normalizing a plan or reading configured inputs.

entries.name: Parse run config source
entries.description: Parse original native control syntax and source ranges after typed validation; literal argv and resource paths remain inert.

entries.name: Inspect run config source
entries.description: Inspect the typed-admitted original control source and its owned URI/ranges without preparing commands or resolving resource paths.

entries.name: Format run config source
entries.description: Format original JSON through the shared native writer, preserving authored fields, literal argv and relative paths without executing them.

entries.name: Parse project json source
entries.description: Parse original native control syntax and source ranges after typed validation; literal argv and resource paths remain inert.

entries.name: Inspect project json source
entries.description: Inspect the typed-admitted original control source and its owned URI/ranges without preparing commands or resolving resource paths.

entries.name: Parse project cem source
entries.description: Parse original native control syntax and source ranges after typed validation; literal argv and resource paths remain inert.

entries.name: Inspect project resources and configurations
entries.description: Inspect the typed-admitted original CEM project syntax, resource paths, configuration references and owned UTF-8 ranges without generic HTML schema validation or project execution.

entries.name: Convert the JSON project to canonical CEM
entries.description: Use the native Studio project codec to produce the canonical CEM control projection with stable IDs and relative reference paths.

entries.name: Convert the CEM project to portable JSON
entries.description: Convert through the same native project model; normalized resource reference paths are preserved without serializing a parser AST.

entries.name: Format the canonical CEM project source
entries.description: Apply the native tabular project writer with exact expected source bytes.

entries.name: Repair the forward CLI command version
entries.description: Restore command schemaVersion 1 after reviewing the native envelope diagnostic. This does not grant unknown argv syntax execution.

entries.name: Repair the forward Studio project version
entries.description: Restore portable project schemaVersion 1. Native reference, path, hash and forbidden-state checks remain active.

entries.name: Build the portable dispatch card
entries.description: Execute the project-relative graph with an explicit heading parameter and HTML entry. Native output spans identify the actual CEM template; source validation alone does not run this build.
